name: Soul AI Chat Agent
tagline: An AI assistant backend that answers from a knowledge base and remembers useful facts about each user.
description: Soul AI is the backend engine for a personalized chat assistant. It answers user questions through an agent that can look up the user's profile, search a knowledge base, and recall facts from earlier conversations, in English or Russian.

coverImage.alt: Soul AI agent flow: user question, agent, tools, and answer

problem: A generic chatbot gives generic answers. This assistant needed to answer from the platform's own knowledge, use what it knows about each user, and stay consistent across conversations.
approach: Use an agent that decides which tool it needs — user profile, knowledge search, or memory — instead of stuffing everything into one prompt. Store knowledge and memories as embeddings so the agent retrieves only what is relevant.
solution: A FastAPI service with a LangGraph agent that calls tools, keeps conversation state, and saves chat history. A memory layer extracts useful facts from messages and ranks them for later recall. A local development mode runs without the database.
features: Agent with tool calling and saved conversation state
Knowledge-base search over embeddings in Supabase
Long-term memory that extracts and recalls user facts
Chat history and threads stored in the database
architecture: Python FastAPI service. A LangGraph loop alternates between the model and three tools. Knowledge chunks and memories live in Supabase PostgreSQL with vector search, using OpenAI embeddings and an OpenAI chat model.
